description: This Java class defines a validator for PatientProgram objects in the OpenMRS healthcare software platform. It performs validation checks such as date consistency, state overlaps, and workflow correctness to ensure data integrity of patient program records.

classes.name: PatientProgramValidator
classes.description: A validator class for PatientProgram, implementing validation logic for patient program records including date checks, workflow consistency, and state management.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines if the validator supports the given class type, specifically checks for PatientProgram class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation on a PatientProgram object, checking for null fields, date correctness, state overlaps, workflow validity, and uniqueness of states within a program.
